ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white to 25% low-intensity black pixels; white dominates the interior regions while black is localized to the peripheral margins and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black banding along the distal-trailing perimeter; dark vertical striations at the inferior-medial base; three dark circular clusters positioned medially near the notch; dark patches extending inward from the lateral-distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees and a relative depth extending roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire continuous trailing boundary; higher amplitude jagged interruptions visible on the distal half of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing margins extending from the central notch vertex to the extreme lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Horizontal triad of dark circular pixel clusters near the central notch; a small cluster of high-intensity white punctate anomalies (barnacles) on the black dorsal-lateral right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark unaligned linear streaks on the left interior lobe; parallel vertical dark rake markings concentrated at the inferior basal margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular erosion and jagged tissue loss along the trailing edge of the left lobe; dark vertical pigmented scarring at the peduncle-fluke interface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical radiating 'flame' pigmentation pattern at the inferior center, characterized by dark pixel streaks penetrating the high-intensity white field.
